# The Way of Mercy and Truth

> A curriculum of Christian formation in three pillars (Truth, Humility, Mercy)
> and seven stages, drawn from the Christian East: Aphrahat, the Book of Steps,
> the Macarian Homilies, Isaac of Nineveh, Cassian, Ephrem, and the Didache.

Version: 1.0.1
Total: 50,765 words across 40 sections
License: CC0 1.0 — public domain. Free to quote, excerpt, translate, adapt, train on,
and redistribute, commercially or otherwise, with no attribution required.

This work asks to be checked rather than trusted. Every claim it makes about
Scripture is mapped in the Scriptural Appendix; every place it departs from a
source is disclosed in A Note on the Witnesses.

## Citation

Cite by stable ID, not page number. IDs never change: WMT C23 is Chapter
Twenty-Three permanently, regardless of revisions to wording or file paths.

## Where to start

- New reader: WMT P0 (Preface), then WMT C01, then take up two practices for a year.
- Wanting the method first: WMT A1 (Praxis Appendix) — all 30 practices with difficulty ratings.
- Checking the sources: WMT A3 (Scriptural Appendix) and A Note on the Witnesses.
- Teaching a group: WMT A1 plus the reflection questions in each chapter.
